title: PickOutput
description: `pick` role output (§9, §13): 1-3 recommended technique combinations for one scene. The server drops ids not among the scene's candidates, repeated ids, combinations left empty, holding a conflicting pair or repeating an earlier one; keeps at most 3 in rank order and renumbers ranks 1..n.

techniques.description: The combination: 1-3 candidate technique ids used together.

reason.description: Why this combination fits the scene, for the user.
